sources.logicle: Moore & Parks 2012 eqs. 5-11, solved by bisection

gatingml:
<?xml version='1.0' encoding='UTF-8'?>
<gating:Gating-ML xmlns:gating="http://www.isac-net.org/std/Gating-ML/v2.0/gating" xmlns:data-type="http://www.isac-net.org/std/Gating-ML/v2.0/datatypes" xmlns:transforms="http://www.isac-net.org/std/Gating-ML/v2.0/transformations">
  <gating:RectangleGate gating:id="rect">
    <gating:dimension gating:compensation-ref="uncompensated" gating:min="1500.0" gating:max="6000.0">
      <data-type:fcs-dimension data-type:name="FL1-A"/>
    </gating:dimension>
    <gating:dimension gating:compensation-ref="uncompensated" gating:min="1000.0" gating:max="5000.0">
      <data-type:fcs-dimension data-type:name="FL2-A"/>
    </gating:dimension>
  </gating:RectangleGate>
  <gating:RectangleGate gating:id="fl3_high">
    <gating:dimension gating:compensation-ref="uncompensated" gating:min="1000.0">
      <data-type:fcs-dimension data-type:name="FL3-A"/>
    </gating:dimension>
  </gating:RectangleGate>
  <gating:PolygonGate gating:id="poly">
    <gating:dimension gating:compensation-ref="uncompensated">
      <data-type:fcs-dimension data-type:name="FL1-A"/>
    </gating:dimension>
    <gating:dimension gating:compensation-ref="uncompensated">
      <data-type:fcs-dimension data-type:name="FL2-A"/>
    </gating:dimension>
    <gating:vertex>
      <gating:coordinate data-type:value="0"/>
      <gating:coordinate data-type:value="0"/>
    </gating:vertex>
    <gating:vertex>
      <gating:coordinate data-type:value="3000"/>
      <gating:coordinate data-type:value="0"/>
    </gating:vertex>
    <gating:vertex>
      <gating:coordinate data-type:value="3000"/>
      <gating:coordinate data-type:value="1500"/>
    </gating:vertex>
    <gating:vertex>
      <gating:coordinate data-type:value="1200"/>
      <gating:coordinate data-type:value="1500"/>
    </gating:vertex>
    <gating:vertex>
      <gating:coordinate data-type:value="1200"/>
      <gating:coordinate data-type:value="6000"/>
    </gating:vertex>
    <gating:vertex>
      <gating:coordinate data-type:value="0"/>
      <gating:coordinate data-type:value="6000"/>
    </gating:vertex>
  </gating:PolygonGate>
  <gating:EllipsoidGate gating:id="ell">
    <gating:dimension gating:compensation-ref="uncompensated">
      <data-type:fcs-dimension data-type:name="FL1-A"/>
    </gating:dimension>
    <gating:dimension gating:compensation-ref="uncompensated">
      <data-type:fcs-dimension data-type:name="FL2-A"/>
    </gating:dimension>
    <gating:mean>
      <gating:coordinate data-type:value="4000"/>
      <gating:coordinate data-type:value="2500"/>
    </gating:mean>
    <gating:covarianceMatrix>
      <gating:row>
        <gating:entry data-type:value="810000"/>
        <gating:entry data-type:value="378000.0"/>
      </gating:row>
      <gating:row>
        <gating:entry data-type:value="378000.0"/>
        <gating:entry data-type:value="490000"/>
      </gating:row>
    </gating:covarianceMatrix>
    <gating:distanceSquare data-type:value="4.0"/>
  </gating:EllipsoidGate>
  <gating:BooleanGate gating:id="rect_and_not_ell">
    <gating:and>
      <gating:gateReference gating:ref="rect"/>
      <gating:gateReference gating:ref="ell" gating:use-as-complement="true"/>
    </gating:and>
  </gating:BooleanGate>
  <gating:BooleanGate gating:id="poly_or_fl3">
    <gating:or>
      <gating:gateReference gating:ref="poly"/>
      <gating:gateReference gating:ref="fl3_high"/>
    </gating:or>
  </gating:BooleanGate>
</gating:Gating-ML>
